newsitem.title: CHINA: ING launches $120 mln China hi-tech fund.
newsitem.headline: ING launches $120 mln China hi-tech fund.

text.p: Dutch financial services group Internationale Nederlanden Groep (ING) NV announced on Tuesday plans to establish a $120 million China high-technology venture capital fund.

The Torch Fund would be set up by ING's investment arm, ING Baring Private Equity Partners, in cooperation with China's State Science and Technology Commission, ING Group executive board member Herman Huizinga told a news conference in Beijing.
The fund would work to attract up to 1.0 billion yuan ($120 million) from domestic investors and would eventually be listed, Huizinga said.
ING officials said fund operations would not begin until the People's Bank of China, the central bank, issued regulations to govern such funds later this year.
"The fund is open especially for small business," he said, adding that ING Group itself would invest $10 million.

The Guangzhou International Trust and Investment Corp would be responsible for finding further investors, while the State Science and Technology Commission would look for potential recipients, Huizinga said.
It could take around two years for the fund to reach its $120 million target, ING officials said.
Huizinga said it would not be listed for at least two to three years to allow time to gain experience and demonstrate results.
